questions.text: Who hosted the meeting on 5<sup style="">th</sup> March?
questions.explanation:
1) Even number of persons hosted the meetings after M and before Q.

2) Q hosted the meeting on 5th of one of the months.

(Let us assume that M hosted the meeting on 5th of one of the given months and let us suppose that two persons (even number) hosted the meeting after M and before Q. That would mean that those two persons would have hosted the meeting on 20th of the same month and 5th of the next month and accordingly Q would have hosted on 20th of the next month. Hence, it is clear now that if even number of persons hosted the meeting after M and before Q and Q hosted the meeting on 5th of one of the months then this means that M must have hosted the meeting on 20th of one of the months.)

3) Three persons hosted the meeting between M and S.

4) S was given a chance to host the meeting in the month which has 31 days in it.

(Using the same logic as above, if three persons hosted the meeting between M and S, implies, S would also have hosted the meeting on 20th of the month. Now there are two months which have 31 days in it i.e. March and May. Implies, S and M must have hosted the meeting on 20th March and 20th May but not necessarily in the same order. If we assume that M hosted the meeting on 20th May then in that case we would not be able to place even number of people between M and Q (Q hosted after M). Implies, M hosted the meeting on 20th March and S hosted the meeting on 20th May. It also means that Q hosted the meeting either on 5th May or 5th June.)

questions.text: Who hosted the meeting in the same month as L?
questions.explanation:
1) Even number of persons hosted the meetings after M and before Q.

2) Q hosted the meeting on 5th of one of the months.

(Let us assume that M hosted the meeting on 5th of one of the given months and let us suppose that two persons (even number) hosted the meeting after M and before Q. That would mean that those two persons would have hosted the meeting on 20th of the same month and 5th of the next month and accordingly Q would have hosted on 20th of the next month. Hence, it is clear now that if even number of persons hosted the meeting after M and before Q and Q hosted the meeting on 5th of one of the months then this means that M must have hosted the meeting on 20th of one of the months.)

3) Three persons hosted the meeting between M and S.

4) S was given a chance to host the meeting in the month which has 31 days in it.

(Using the same logic as above, if three persons hosted the meeting between M and S, implies, S would also have hosted the meeting on 20th of the month. Now there are two months which have 31 days in it i.e. March and May. Implies, S and M must have hosted the meeting on 20th March and 20th May but not necessarily in the same order. If we assume that M hosted the meeting on 20th May then in that case we would not be able to place even number of people between M and Q (Q hosted after M). Implies, M hosted the meeting on 20th March and S hosted the meeting on 20th May. It also means that Q hosted the meeting either on 5th May or 5th June.)
